title: [DocDB] [Table locks] Could not locate master leader after master restart
body:
Jira Link: [DB-18267](https://yugabyte.atlassian.net/browse/DB-18267)
### Description

Encountering an issue in the table level locks stress tests in version 2.27.0.0-b497
There were no master leader even though all masters are up ,  and Failing with could not locate master leader  at one point of the test .hence unable to establish any connections and tests failed.
Looks like leader elections happening in loop.
Along with following master error in 2 of the nodes
```
E0829 05:33:25.307617  8365 consensus_peers.cc:188] T 00000000000000000000000000000000 P c05466a70f744aa88534495d11784076 -> Peer 55a392a4e0664ab5aee574f0e08ff329 ([host: "172.151.30.233" port: 7100], []): Found an RPC call in stuck state - timeout: 3.000s, last_rpc_start_time: 3569.590s, stuck threshold: 10.000s, force recover: 0, call state: RPC call 0x0000132df71a8700: yb.consensus.ConsensusService.UpdateConsensus -> { remote: 172.151.30.233:7100 idx: 5 protocol: 0x000056403dc275c8 -> tcpc }, id: 11264, state: SENT, transfer_state: FINISHED, start_time: 3569.590s (13.429s ago), sent_time: 3579.682s (3.337s ago), trigger_callback_time: -inf, invoke_callback_time: -inf, expiration_time: 3582.682s (0.337s ago), now: 3583.019s, connection: Connection (0x0000132dfb06d360) client 172.151.21.20:37923 => 172.151.30.233:7100, active_call_state: kAdded

```
master has threads related to objectlockmanager... when i inspected it is up. System deadlock ?
